svg.title: Customer Churn MLOps — C4 component view of the worker
svg.desc: C4 component diagram of the worker: three Prefect deployments trigger the flows; the full flow first runs four blocking code gates (ruff format, ruff check, bandit, pytest), then prepare-data, train-model, evaluate-model and save/load. After a run, flows.py logs it to the MLflow server through tracking.py and prints a JSON event through observability.py; save/load writes classifier.joblib to the ./models volume.
